system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

function.name: pmkusum_verify_installation
function.description: Records the physical verification/inspection result for the installed solar pump. Transitions installation_status from 'completed' to 'verified' upon passing. Verification is REQUIRED before subsidy disbursement. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if installation is not 'completed', inspection finds defects, or installation is incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

function.name: pmkusum_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for PM-KUSUM operations. Does NOT check eligibility or application status. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated via pmkusum_generate_otp.
